Definition: properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid
BiblicalUsage: This word means brutish — the stupid man, the fool who has no understanding. Proverbs says the brutish man knoweth not, and the fool cannot understand, and the psalm says the man that is in honour and understandeth not is like the beasts that perish. A man can have honour and still be a beast, if he will not learn.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the brutish man is the one who refuses correction. I hold that the fear of the Lord is the only cure for a mind that will not learn.
